techs.name: NULL
techs.notes: Joins (Ch8). Strip tags, resistances and buffs for 2 turns (allies in the circle too). On a weaknessless target, create one fake weakness from the 42-entry pool for 2 turns.

techs.name: Miura Fold
techs.notes: Two enemies. The two share one HP pool for 2 turns; on the snap, everything dealt to the pool is split back between them as true damage.

techs.name: Lotus Reverse
techs.notes: Unfolds an ally 3 s back: cancels a KO from the last 3 s, refunds MP spent in them, cleanses; leaves a paper decoy that draws one enemy action.

techs.name: Gold Leaf Severance
techs.notes: Costs 3-5 Gold Leaf stacks (no engine cost key; the effect must check them). Cuts the timeline into a one-turn washi pocket where only NULL exists: every enemy is TRUE NULL and every party hit deals true damage. Vaelos is locked out (his next action is skipped).
